convex_actual_source_solids.method: Closed oriented source triangles must equal their exact vertex convex hull volume; hull is then usable for continuous containment/intersection, not an enclosing approximation of an opening

actual_contact_connectivity.method: Full semantic-part graph using actual vertex/triangle boundaries, enclosed points, edge/triangle and coplanar-edge intersections. AABB only rejects separated pairs; it never establishes contact.
actual_contact_connectivity.limits: Geometric connectivity, not structural design, attachment strength, irrigation, load, or simulation behavior. Open folded foliage is not treated as a closed support hull.

physical_support_patches.method: Every polygon vertex lies within the actual convex support; same-plane normal and distance at vertices, edge midpoints and centre establish entire convex patch surface, including winding

whole_void_volumes.method: Convex halfspace intersection maximizes inscribed radius; actual named meshes verified convex first. AABB rejects disjoint pairs only. Positive-volume negative controls placed within real source/detailed/body geometry.

omitted_details.interpretation: Euclidean source-surface distance to retained body solid union; Sampled maximum is a lower bound. For each retained convex hull, maximum vertex distance bounds the entire convex omitted part by convexity of distance; the minimum such bound certifies distance to the retained union. The independently reported sample-grid Lipschitz bound is looser. This is not material thickness.

whole_nested_profile.method: Eight actual inward-facing source shell planes form convex cavity; buried segment-end faces are excluded only when their outward centroid probe enters an adjacent actual shell solid. Every evaluated carrier and locator vertex satisfies every plane; linearity proves all edges, triangles and contained solids, not only centres or bounding boxes. Lid cap intentionally covers shell rim rather than fitting within cavity.

manual_detached_handling_sweeps.method: For each convex named part and straight translation leg, convex hull of endpoint copies is the exact continuous swept solid. Positive-volume intersection tested against each stationary actual part. Starts at true closed/seated state. No retained-joint claim.

states.carrier_support_status: Detached and externally held, intentionally no support claim

limits: Geometric component proposals only; no host/shop/activity-slot/door adoption or transaction behavior.
No universal body/species/reach/hand fit, load, forces, mechanical retention, runtime implementation or engine performance acceptance.
Native state checks verify exported positions by ownership/material and physical marker surfaces; main reviewer handles full corner/material/export/source-only/preservation audits.
